cs.t:
HP Elitebook x360 1030 G2 (maybe another order of words)
i5 7-something
8GB
Aluminium case I needed a laptop, specifically a convertible for note taking by hand too. Went on ebay, could decide between a Thinkpad and the HP. Actually wanted the Thinkpad, but wasn't available on that day, so I went with the HP I run both Windows for school and Linux for private stuff on it. Aside from some annoying things like freezes when converting, it works. Definitely not the machine of my dreams and HP annoys me a little bit, but overall decent device for what I need. Also cost only like 300€ or something. Can't understand how people carry their 2k MacBooks around in their backpack without worrying constantly
cs.th: Ask HN: What brand of laptop do you use?
